perItemFindings.one_line: Delivered tier incremental < floor field; not salvageable within scope.

verbatim_critique:
[D0.5.G cold referee] delivered tier=incremental below novelty_target=field (floor=field). The note proves a substantive one-sided converse: the nonprivate floor and two pure-DP lower-bound radii on the exact-uniform class, plus their monotonicity transfer to the larger Kennedy-Theorem-1 slice. It does not prove an estimator attaining any of these privacy terms; the claimed minimax equivalence is entirely conditional on the unresolved full-fiber occupancy lift, while the occupancy identity and shell proposition do not establish that lift. The TL;DR, setup, and scope correctly label the matching frontier as conditional, so there is no separate stale assertion of an unconditional match, but the delivered result remains a converse and construction toolkit rather than a sparse-to-dense frontier. The absence of achievability, a resolved full-fiber score construction, and supporting evidence that nuisance profiling avoids an entropy penalty keeps the contribution below the field target and limits its leading-journal score. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 5.2 < 7.2, so the graded tier 'subfield' is capped at 'incremental'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]

HALTED AT TRIAGE: the math panel returned `revise` and its findings were never repaired, so this note is NOT established as mathematically sound — do not bank it as downgraded on this verdict alone. Open findings: closest_prior_missing@thm:full-class-lower-frontier
